# REMAINING WORK — UI, Performance, Publish Continuation

The Awtsmoos renews every byte and route; Awtsmoos.com must reveal speed with truth, not haste with doubt.
A release is not a push alone: source, browser, server, Git, deployment, and production must all sing the same account.

## Known Work

- [ ] Repair stale Sefarim presentation contracts exposed by the test run.
- [ ] Remove dead active-search selectors for hero elements that no longer exist.
- [ ] Reread every newly touched Sefarim source/test file.
- [ ] Run focused Sefarim tests with an exit code that cannot be masked by later shell commands.
- [ ] Run live `/mawgawl/sefarim/?q=space+travel&mode=library` browser verification.
- [ ] Verify desktop, 768px, 430px, and short-height layouts.
- [ ] Verify Search Options, Library Context, query hydration, search, history, lane, scope, and clear-history interactions.
- [ ] Measure navigation timing, resource count, transfer sizes where available, long tasks, and console/network failures.
- [ ] Inspect `ayzarim/awtsmoosDynamicServer` for the real compact implementation and `compact=true` semantics.
- [ ] Use compact mode only where the server contract proves it is beneficial and correct.
- [ ] Run the existing sitewide runtime auditor against public routes after focused Sefarim success.
- [ ] Continue into the highest-impact clean broken routes while avoiding collisions with active owners.
- [ ] Secret-scan the complete repository before publication.
- [ ] Refresh branch/remotes/ahead-behind and inspect deploy scripts/workflows.
- [ ] Stage and commit the complete requested repository snapshot, including unrelated safe changes.
- [ ] Push the complete snapshot to GitHub.
- [ ] Execute the repository's actual deployment/publish mechanism.
- [ ] Smoke-test production Awtsmoos.com after deployment, including performance and console errors.
- [ ] Record planned-vs-actual release delta and close every remaining safe item.

## Evidence Already Obtained

- The Sefarim combined read/test job completed and exposed stale UI tests rather than allowing false completion.
- `searchFoldContract.test.mjs` still requires the old horizontal mobile context carousel and removed hero structures.
- `styles/active-search.css` still refers to `.library-hero-copy`, `.library-truth-row`, and `.library-hero-mark`, all retired by the new entry markup.
- The real dynamic server root is `ayzarim/awtsmoosDynamicServer`; the earlier literal spaced path does not exist.
- `searchMode.test.mjs` is behavioral and should remain semantically intact unless its own failure proves otherwise.

## Release Gates

1. Source gate: no stale selectors/contracts, all touched source <=120 lines.
2. Test gate: focused tests green with direct failure propagation.
3. Browser gate: real public route functional, responsive, no site-owned errors.
4. Performance gate: measured fast loading; compact path evaluated from real server code.
5. Repository gate: secret scan and Git topology safe.
6. Publish gate: full requested snapshot pushed.
7. Deployment gate: real publish command/workflow executed.
8. Production gate: public route and representative pages smoke-tested after deployment.

## NEXT_ACTION

Complete the three planning passes, then rewrite the stale active-search source and presentation-contract test as complete files before rerunning focused tests.
